allowed_manuscript_claim: IMmotion150 + JAVELIN comparable fixed-effect synthesis supports a pooled HR_int < 1 (p < 0.001).
Random-effects synthesis remains <1, with a wider CI reflecting between-trial heterogeneity.
Bayesian synthesis with weakly informative, moderate, and strong skeptical priors all give posterior Pr(HR_int<1) ≈ 0.9995–0.9996 anchored on the FE estimate.
Anchored on the random-effects pooled estimate, posterior Pr(HR_int<1) ≈ 0.977–0.983 across priors.
